changes.before: Embedding quality checks directly into data pipelines enables fail-closed governance. We show how Great Expectations suites catch schema drifts and null fields before documents reach the embedding model.

Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) significantly improves large language model accuracy by grounding responses in retrieved passages. We explore agentic multi-hop reasoning and routing across heterogeneous vector indices.
Dense vector search excels at conceptual similarity but struggles with exact acronyms and serial numbers. Reciprocal Rank Fusion of sparse lexical scores and dense embeddings achieves optimal recall.
